currency_assumptions: All venue prices are published in CAD. Every USD comparison figure uses the Bank of Canada FXCADUSD rate for 2026-11-23: 1 CAD = 0.6959 USD (US dollars per Canadian dollar), rounded to the nearest whole US dollar.

A published day rate is recorded with its hire window as price_detail.cost_rate_unit and price_detail.estimated_hours; it is not a quoted package price, and a window it does not cover is not inferred.
A published event rate is recorded per event, not per hour; where the listing does not state the hours it covers, the figure is not converted into an 8 h or 12 h package.
The soft budget for scoring is USD 5,000; exactly USD 5,000 is not over budget, and cost is never a gate.

declared_gaps.text: The three Collectif MTL rooms are pinned to the Rue Sainte-Catherine Ouest street segment, not a door: OSM has no house number 397A, and four lookups returned only the street or no result.
Mon Loft Privé is a street-segment pin: OSM has no house number 9 on Rue Sainte-Catherine Est; the previous point was on the Village gai segment about a kilometre east.

Three building pins carry a postcode conflict: Maison Tela operator H3L 2Z8 vs OSM H3L 2V7; Centre humaniste H2J 1L7 vs H2J 1L5; Tango Renaissance H2W 1Z8 vs H2W 1Z5. The point is the building frontage.

42 of the 48 platform-listing photo records remain withheld: Eventective and Tagvenue host the files without a licence, and the operators' own sites publish no matching gallery image for those URLs. Two Eventective default_space.jpg placeholders were dropped.
17 of 32 venues still have no cleared room photograph; the cleared set is 45 operator-gallery images across 15 venues, with the operator sites publishing no room gallery for the rest.

CNESST's Jours fériés page was blocked by Cloudflare (HTTP 403, also via r.jina.ai) on 2026-11-26; the Quebec dates come from the Loi sur les normes du travail and the Loi sur la fête nationale, and CNESST remains unread.

The CSSDM 2026-2027 FGJ calendar prints 23 April and 4 June 2027 as non-teaching days but does not print the Semaine de relâche dates in the extracted PDF, so no March-break row is claimed for the French board.
Neither the CSSDM nor the EMSB 2027-2028 calendar is published, so July-December 2027 is uncovered for both school scopes; the 2026-2027 editions cover January-June 2027.
The EMSB 2026-2027 dated calendar prints National Patriots' Day on both 18 May and 24 May 2027; the statute's Monday-before-25-May rule fixes 24 May and the internal conflict is recorded.

Only three events print 2027 dates on an organiser page: ALL IN (22-23 September), Startupfest (7-9 July) and the DC Finance Montreal Family Office conference (3 May). Luma's city page, the six Meetup groups and AI Tinkerers Montreal published no 2027 theme event; Luma MTL and Montréal aliases both 404.

Seven access claims carry no hire interval. CARNEGIE, JUNIPER and THE HOOK publish only an appointment window ('By appointment from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. weekdays; By appointment weekends') and a Tagvenue openingHoursSpecification; Studio Cuero publishes only 'Studio hours 7:00am - 10:00pm'; IMAGEMOTION sells day (8am-5pm) and evening (5pm-3am) blocks separately, so twelve hours is refused; Kawalees publishes 12:00-24:00, which does not contain 09:00-21:00; Centre humaniste prices 4-, 8- and 12-hour rentals but publishes only an appointment block. No Montreal venue now carries a twelve-hour yes.

Noel 2027 falls on a Saturday. Article 60 of the Loi sur les normes du travail prints the seven statutory days and no substitute date for a holiday landing on a non-working day, so none is stored. The compensatory-day practice CNESST would confirm could not be read: cnesst.gouv.qc.ca returned a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403, also via r.jina.ai) on 2026-11-26. Treat the 25 December row as the statutory date only, not a settled observed closure.

Five catering values had no locator or quote and are downgraded to unknown: Mise au Jeu, Le Balcon, Van Houtte, Centre humaniste and Les Connections Ralia. The captured listings print no catering-policy line (Mise au Jeu prints only 'On-Site Catering Service', which does not establish in-house-only). The other fourteen of the nineteen catering claims are now cited to a line that carries the value.

alcohol.quote: Le permis de réunion « pour servir » est destiné à toute personne, physique ou morale, qui souhaite offrir gratuitement aux participants, lors d'une activité qu'elle organise, des boissons alcooliques qu'elle a achetées ou qui veut permettre la consommation de boissons alcooliques apportées par les participants.
alcohol.source_locator: Definition and 'Activité pour laquelle le permis de réunion « pour servir » n'est pas requis'
alcohol.source_title: RACJ — Permis de réunion « pour servir »

translation_review.gloss: A meeting permit 'to serve' covers free alcohol bought by the organizer or alcohol brought by participants at an organized activity; it does not allow selling alcohol.
translation_review.review: French quotation kept with its locator; the gloss was read for the decision-bearing words and leaves the applicability question open rather than asserting compliance.

value.observed_rule: required to offer free alcohol or allow BYO at an organized activity; apply at least 15 days ahead; not required for a private activity with fewer than 200 people, invited guests only, no public advertising, free or BYO alcohol, and no existing alcohol permit on the premises
value.unknown: whether admission fees or public ticketing make the event non-private, and which permit the venue or caterer already holds

verification_questions: Confirm whether the event is private under the RACJ test, or needs a meeting permit, and who applies.
Confirm the permit holder, service model, insurance and last call with the venue and caterer.

food.quote: Certaines activités requièrent des permis spécifiques, notamment les activités sans but lucratif, les événements de courte durée ou la fourniture de services contre rémunération.
food.source_locator: Permit scope paragraph and processing-delay section
food.source_title: MAPAQ / Québec.ca — Permis pour préparation d'aliments, restauration ou vente au détail

translation_review.gloss: Some activities require specific permits, including non-profit activities, short-duration events and paid services.
translation_review.review: French quotation kept with its locator; the gloss was read for the decision-bearing words and leaves the applicability question open rather than asserting compliance.

value.observed_rule: food permits are administered by MAPAQ; short-duration events, non-profit activities and paid catering services require a specific permit, and processing takes 2 to 6 weeks
value.unknown: which permit applies to the chosen caterer or venue kitchen, who holds it, and whether drop-off food is treated differently from on-site preparation

verification_questions: Ask the caterer for its MAPAQ permit and the permit class that covers this event model.
Confirm whether the venue kitchen may be used and who is responsible for the food-safety plan.

language.quote: L'affichage public et la publicité commerciale doivent se faire en français. Ils peuvent être également faits à la fois en français et dans une ou plusieurs autres langues pourvu que tous les messages qui composent l'affichage soient rédigés en français et que l'ensemble des éléments figurant dans le même champ visuel permettent d'assurer la nette prédominance du français dans l'affichage.
language.source_locator: Opening rule paragraph: 'Affichage public et publicité commerciale'
language.source_title: OQLF — Affichage des marques de commerce et des noms d'entreprises

translation_review.gloss: Public signage and commercial advertising must be in French; French and another language are allowed only where French is markedly predominant in the same visual field.
translation_review.review: French quotation kept with its locator; the gloss was read for the decision-bearing words and leaves the applicability question open rather than asserting compliance.

value.applies_to: the organizer's public event page, registration form, on-site signage and printed programme
value.observed_rule: public signage and commercial advertising must be in French; French and another language are allowed only where French is markedly predominant
value.unknown: whether a private, invitation-only 50-person event's materials are commercial advertising, and which surface the venue controls rather than the organizer

verification_questions: Determine which event surfaces are commercial advertising for this organizer, and whether the venue or the organizer owns each surface.
Obtain approved French copy before any public release, not a machine-translated compliance claim.
